mapper.select: select distinct question.id as question_id, question.title as question_title from question_submit inner join question on question_submit.question_id = question.id where question_submit.user_id = #{userId} and question_submit.judge_status = 2 and question_submit.question_result = 1 and question_submit.is_deleted = 0 and question.is_deleted = 0 and question.check_status=1 order by question.id asc

select distinct question.id as question_id, question.title as question_title from question_submit inner join question on question_submit.question_id = question.id where question_submit.user_id = #{userId} and question_submit.judge_status = 2 and question_submit.question_result = 2 and question_submit.is_deleted = 0 and question.is_deleted = 0 and question.check_status=1 and not exists ( select * from question_submit where question_submit.question_id = question.id and question_submit.user_id = #{userId} and question_submit.judge_status = 2 and question_submit.question_result = 1 and question_submit.is_deleted = 0 ) order by question.id asc

SELECT id, question_id, user_id, language, code, judge_status, question_result, judge_result_info, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time FROM question_submit LEFT JOIN question on question_submit.question_id = question.id and question.is_deleted = 0 WHERE id = #{id} and question.check_status=1
